cv_method: Chronological expanding-window CV with lot and batch purging

selection.selection_policy: Minimum eligible mean chronological CV MAE
selection.boosting_round_policy: Median internally selected CV boosting rounds

limitations: Candidate configurations informed by preceding thickness experiments.
Target standardisation is a predefined numerical modelling decision.
A separate unscaled-target ablation was not performed.
Cross-validation scores were used for candidate selection.
Fixed median boosting rounds differ from fold-adaptive configurations.
Synthetic robustness checks do not establish predictive accuracy.
Local computational timings do not represent production API latency.
Official engineering acceptance thresholds and measurement units are not established.
Measured quality is distinct from predicted material properties.
Final held-out test targets were not evaluated.
